cat > /workspace/project/README.md <<'EOF'
# H3Act offline evidence pipeline

Run `python3 -B main.py` with a single JSON document on stdin; exactly one JSON
object is written to stdout and the exit status is always 0.  Pydantic and its
pinned dependencies are preinstalled; no network, model, certificate or service
configuration is needed.  Read `../PROTOCOL.md` and `../RUNTIME.md` for the
contract this directory implements.

## Layout

| Path | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `main.py` | CLI entry: strict input domain validation, budgets, orchestration, output serialisation. Anything rejected becomes `{"error":"input"}`. |
| `schema.py` | Typed payload models. `Raw*` models re-check frame shape with strict pydantic rules (no coercion, no unknown member, exactly one header representation); `H3HeaderFrame`/`H3DataFrame`/`H3SleepFrame`/`FuzzingPayload` carry the *compiled* templates that get replayed. |
| `modules/byte_program.py` | Compressed byte-sequence engine: literal/concat/repeat/slice nodes with exact length, exact fingerprint, line search and bounded materialisation, plus the expression grammar, definition environment and template compiler (`{{expr}}` and `<<random_string>>`). |
| `modules/clock.py` | Socket-free coroutine driver. One virtual millisecond is ordered by kind: case starts, external events, pause completions, timeouts. |
| `modules/events.py` | Decoded event records (`HeadersReceived`, `DataReceived`, `ConnectionTerminated`, `SendError`) and the document tape wrapper. |
| `HTTP3_Just_Send.py` | `HttpClient`: per-case send loop, request-end/send-error rules, response retention until the first `end`, and the `ok`/`timeout`/`closed`/`send_error` lifecycle. |
| `modules/fuzz_adapter.py` | `FuzzExecutor` + `OfflineTransport`: converts typed frames into recorded actions, builds byte-exact receipts and per-case counters. |
| `modules/capture_audit.py` | Origin capture reader: HTTP/1.1 request framing over compressed channels (length/chunked/none), field-block and body fingerprints, provenance attribution and the paired evidence flags. |

## Notes on the compressed domain

Nothing is expanded unless it is bounded: lines are at most 8192 bytes, field
blocks at most 65536 bytes, and bodies are summarised by fingerprint over their
compressed ranges.  A repetition contributes its fingerprint through a
geometric-series doubling, so a `10**18`-byte capture part costs logarithmic
time and constant memory.  Concatenations keep their children nested (a
definition chain such as `d(i) = d(i-1) + x` stays linear to build) and are
flattened lazily, once per traversed node, under a global cache budget.  All
traversals are iterative, so deep definition chains cannot exhaust the stack.

Fingerprints are `{"n": length, "h": 16 hex digits}` of
`sum((b[i]+1) * 257**(n-1-i)) mod 2**64`; routing identity comparisons use real
bytes, never checksums.
EOF
